name: faq-knowledge-base
description: Build and maintain the question/answer knowledge base that bots and auto-replies answer from: mine real questions, write short answers with review dates, collect customers' own phrasings, lint for duplicates, empty answers, stale facts and confusable entries (0-100), and measure coverage on real traffic with clusters of unanswered questions. JSON format shared with telegram-bot and smart-reply-router.
